mobbin:08aa493c-6111-43eb-a393-4f09e8b5f.summary: A recruiter opens a candidate overview, adds a Project scorecard with free-text notes and Strong Yes to Strong No, then sees 'Scorecard Submitted' with the saved Strong Yes card.
steps: Scorecard with notes and Strong Yes to No
Submitted message and Strong Yes card
steal: An empty Scorecards screen offers 'Add scorecard for [name]' (screen 2).
A footer rating strip shows Strong Yes, Yes, No and Strong No in color (screen 3).
'View all previous scorecards' sits above the form (screen 3).
A success banner 'Scorecard Submitted!' then a list card shows reviewer, Strong Yes and the note (screen 6).
avoid: A free-text-only scorecard with no checklist criteria fits SRV grading worse than an Abbott-style checklist with timestamps.
mobbin:08aa493c-6111-43eb-a393-4f09e8b5f.fit: Recording: extends SRV Data Entry with a right-rail scorecard, a final four-step scale and confirmation, but lacks evidence timestamps and rubric rows.
